title: An Agentic Approach with Evidence-Grounded Verification for Multimodal Emotion Reasoning in Conversation
abstract: arXiv:2610.31685v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM-based multimodal emotion reasoning systems perform well on standard benchmarks, but improving them through instruction tuning can be computationally expensive. Agentic pipelines built from frozen models avoid this cost, but introduce a different challenge: when a prediction is wrong, the system must identify which agent or stage caused the error. We address this problem with an agentic framework for traceable multimodal emotion reasoning and prompt-space adaptation. Modality-specific perception agents analyze visual, acoustic, and lexical inputs and post evidence-cited observations to a shared board. An integration agent combines these observations with retrieved multimodal examples to produce an emotion description, label set, and supporting citations, while an MLLM critic can request one revision before the output is finalized. For incorrect predictions, a separate evidence-grounded verification stage applies deterministic checks

translated_title: 一种基于证据校验的智能体方法，用于对话中的多模态情感推理
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的多模态情感推理系统在标准基准测试中表现良好，但通过指令微调来改进它们的计算成本可能很高。由冻结模型构建的智能体流水线可以避免这一成本，但带来了另一个挑战：当预测出错时，系统必须识别是哪个智能体或哪个阶段导致了错误。我们通过一个可追溯的多模态情感推理与提示空间自适应的智能体框架来解决这一问题。针对特定模态的感知智能体分析视觉、声学和文本输入，并将附带证据引用的观察结果发布到共享看板上。一个集成智能体将这些观察结果与检索到的多模态示例相结合，生成情感描述、标签集合以及支持性引用，同时多模态大语言模型（MLLM）评论者可以在输出最终确定之前要求进行一次修订。对于错误的预测，一个独立的基于证据的验证阶段会执行确定性检查
tldr: 该论文提出了一种可追溯的多模态情感推理智能体框架，通过模态感知智能体发布带证据引用的观察、集成智能体生成情感标签与引用，并利用独立的基于证据的验证阶段执行确定性检查来定位错误来源，从而以低成本实现对话中的多模态情感推理。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a traceable agentic framework for multimodal emotion reasoning in conversation, where modality-specific perception agents post evidence-cited observations, an integration agent produces emotion labels with supporting citations, and a separate evidence-grounded verification stage applies deterministic checks to localize errors, avoiding the cost of instruction tuning.
